name: official-pusht-action-space-reset-diagnostic
purpose: Identify why the prepared reset action differs across paired Stage 1 paths despite seeding world.envs.envs[0].action_space before World.reset(seed). Do not weaken or bypass the action-key pairing gate.

scope.per_seed_order: Reproduce the frozen Stage 1 randomized main-path order and fidelity-path order using their existing order-seed bases.
scope.operations: Construct a fresh official stable_worldmodel.World for each path label, inspect the concrete EnvPool wrapper chain and action_space object identities, seed the concrete outer action space exactly as Stage 1 does, then call World.reset(seed) and capture world.infos['action'].
scope.instrumentation: Temporarily wrap Gymnasium Space.seed and Space.sample methods in this standalone process; delegate each call unchanged and record space identity, arguments, return summary, and order. Record exact low-dimensional action values; summarize any large samples with shape, dtype, min, max, and first eight values.
not_in_scope: changing the Stage 1 observation key set or gate

source_provenance: The official World, EnvPool, and reset-wrapper sources are the staging snapshots used by the parent experiment. Their commit identifiers are staging provenance/reference only; this diagnostic reports the runtime import root and API identities without claiming exact-commit runtime verification.
